title: A2/R-157/R-158 v0.1.10 charge-scope repair compile and replay
question: Does the v0.1.10 charge-scope correction preserve the mathematical paper source, PDF integrity, and registered A2/R-157/R-158 executable evidence?
decision_reason: The narrowed wording removes a claim stronger than the current R-158 proof while preserving all equations, constants, theorem statements, and executable evidence. A fresh Tectonic build, rendered-page review, source/PDF structural checks, and A2/R-157/R-158 replay all pass.
evidence_level: T5 repository-local source/PDF and executable regression; no external proof audit
finding: Manuscript v0.1.10 compiles with bundled Tectonic to a 12-page PDF. Source QA reports 69 labels, 32 references with no missing targets, zero non-whitespace controls, zero placeholders, zero unescaped qquad tokens, and no overfull, underfull, undefined-reference, or citation-warning markers. All 12 pages render; the contact sheet and representative changed pages are legible. A2 full production passes 61/61, R-157 integrated passes 144/144, R-158 integrated passes 155/155 with regression, and the exploration ledger verifies 1382 records.
method: Compile the corrected manuscript source with the bundled Tectonic compiler after the PDF edit marker.
Run source/PDF structural checks for labels, references, control bytes, placeholders, equation-control hygiene, PDF page count, and compiler warnings.
Render all PDF pages at 150 dpi with Poppler, review the contact sheet and the changed introduction, ensemble, and conclusion pages.
Run the registered A2 full-production, R-157 integrated, R-158 integrated, and exploration-ledger verifiers.
Confirm that the wording repair changes no theorem tier, source coefficient, executable assertion, or scope firewall.
assumptions: The compiled PDF is generated from the current v0.1.10 manuscript source in the publish folder.
The registered executable lanes remain the authority for exact arithmetic and provenance checks.
The concurrent PAH process is separate and its generated files do not constitute evidence for this paper.
missing_assumptions: Independent mathematician sign-off on the A2 analytic proof and the R-158 direct-method/selection boundary.
Specialist novelty review, operator confirmation, capstone bundle, and clean repository release check.
boundary: A2/R-157/R-158 integrated paper source, PDF, and repository-local replay only. No external proof sign-off, novelty decision, claim-tier change, physical interpretation, infinite-volume or continuum result, submission, upload, tag, or release.
revisit_condition: Reopen if the external proof audit rejects the revised charge boundary or if the manuscript source, canonical claims, or replay results change.
stop_or_redesign: Do not advance the lifecycle from draft on the basis of compile or executable PASS alone.
Do not restore a global-charge jump claim without a new selection/stability proof.
Keep the current PDF and source synchronized with the v0.1.10 wording before any capstone build.
non_claims: The replay confirms repository-local consistency, not analytic theorem closure.
The 12-page PDF is a draft artifact and not a submission or publication record.
No external referee or specialist novelty opinion has been received.
The concurrent PAH work remains independent and does not change this paper status.

adversarial_review.check: Could the added qualification be omitted from the PDF or source during a later rebuild?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED FOR THIS CHECKPOINT: source and compiled PDF were compared by version text and rendered-page inspection; future builds must rerun the same QA.

adversarial_review.check: Could executable PASS counts be read as proof of the analytic charge-selection statement?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED AS OVERCLAIM: the manuscript, proof-audit, and verification README retain the selection/stability question as open.

adversarial_review.check: Could the 12-page expansion indicate a layout defect?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: all pages render with legible margins and no overfull/underfull markers; representative changed pages were inspected.

adversarial_review.check: Could this replay close the publication gate?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS LIMITATION: independent proof, specialist, operator, capstone, and release gates remain open.

next_action: Keep v0.1.10 at draft and route the updated proof-audit questions to an independent mathematician; after signed review and operator confirmation, build the dedicated capstone bundle and rerun the repository release gate.
